ai_summary: ABC is a national digital credit bank letting HEI students store and transfer academic credits.
ai_explanation: The Academic Bank of Credits gives each student an ABC ID to accumulate credits earned from participating universities, which can later be transferred toward a degree under the National Credit Framework. It promotes flexible, multiple-entry learning.
eligibility_summary: Students of participating Higher Education Institutions.
